manifest.title: ISM Code Element 2 - Pilot Question 1 (end-to-end pipeline proof)

questionPayload.learningObjective: Identify the Company's primary obligation under ISM Code Element 2 regarding a safety and environmental-protection policy.
questionPayload.prompt: According to Element 2 of the ISM Code, what is the Company's primary obligation regarding a safety and environmental-protection policy?

choices.text: Establish a safety and environmental-protection policy describing how the objectives in paragraph 1.2 will be achieved
Develop it in cooperation with the flag State
Submit it to the IMO for approval
Review it only after an accident occurs

questionPayload.expectedReasoning: The verbatim ISM Code text (para 2.1) uses 'establish', not 'develop' - this exact distinction was a documented, twice-repeated Gemini verification error during source sourcing (see PILOT-001.json's Element 2 knownDiscrepancy field). Distractor B intentionally encodes that error.
